places: Nay Pyi Taw is the administrative capital

fields.climate: tropical monsoon; cloudy, rainy, hot, humid summers (southwest monsoon, June to September); less cloudy, scant rainfall, mild temperatures, lower humidity during winter (northeast monsoon, December to April)
fields.terrain: central lowlands ringed by steep, rugged highlands
fields.hazards: destructive earthquakes and cyclones; flooding and landslides common during rainy season (June to September); periodic droughts
fields.resources: petroleum, timber, tin, antimony, zinc, copper, tungsten, lead, coal, marble, limestone, precious stones, natural gas, hydropower, arable land
fields.farm: rice, sugarcane, vegetables, beans, maize, groundnuts, plantains, fruits, coconuts, onions
fields.exports: garments, natural gas, dried legumes, rare-earth metal compounds, precious stones
fields.industries: agricultural processing; wood and wood products; copper, tin, tungsten, iron; cement, construction materials; pharmaceuticals; fertilizer; oil and natural gas; garments; jade and gems
fields.religions: Buddhist 87.9%, Christian 6.2%, Muslim 4.3%, Animist 0.8%, Hindu 0.5%, other 0.2%, none 0.1%
fields.legal: mixed legal system of English common law (as introduced in codifications designed for colonial India) and customary law
fields.military: 18-35 years of age (men) and 18-27 years of age (women) for voluntary and conscripted military service; 24-month service obligation…
